title: Scalar Hom map after module raw pullback expansion
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring in Type(u+1), W,S schemes in universe u, k:W→S, G an etale Λ-module sheaf on W, q a natural number, U∈S.Etale, A,B∈Over(W), f:A→B and z a raw module class at B. The scalar Hom map at A evaluated on the module raw pullback of z equals scalarSourceFactor at A.hom≫k followed by derived scalar forgetting of moduleSourceFactor, derived scalar forgetting of the derived module inverse image of z, and derived scalar forgetting of moduleCoefficientFactor, followed by scalarCoefficientFactor at A.hom. No source coherence, inverse derived scalar comparison, abelian source factor or abelian raw pullback is used.

source.document: Stacks Project; the explicit definition rawModuleAbelianHomMap

proof.text: Apply the proved rawModuleScalarHom_evaluate equation to the raw pullback class at A. This identifies the bundled additive map with scalarSourceFactor, derived scalar forgetting of the raw pullback, and scalarCoefficientFactor.

Apply the private generic map_three_factors lemma to derived scalar forgetting and the displayed source/class/coefficient factors. Prove its raw input equation using the private raw_triangle_whisker lemma: for an arbitrary represented functor L and two source functors H and H′, evaluation of rawTriangleMap on the whiskered source comparison equals rawTriangleSource evaluated at L(U), followed by the class and coefficient maps. The generic proof unfolds only rawTriangleMap, rawTriangleSource and whiskering, then uses Category.assoc. Specialize to the free represented sheaf functor, the module inverse-image functors, the two single functors and the shared coefficient factor. Definitional equality identifies the raw Over map and the original Sheaf factor definitions without importing their conflicting upstream twins. Compose with the evaluation equation from step 1. No source coherence or coefficient-square theorem is used; degree zero, zero classes and identity arrows are included.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalar_hom_composite_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op B)) :
    rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).map f.op z) =
      scalarSourceFactor Λ (A.hom ≫ k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (moduleSourceFactor Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
          (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w]) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map z) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (moduleCoefficientFactor Λ G (q : ℤ) A B f) ≫
      scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ)
